note: City holiday pages (QUEUE G16 step 4, OWNER D32). One record per event, read on the page named. An event leaves after end_on; a price older than 30 days shows Check live. No year in the URL: refreshed each season.

new-york-city.hero_place: Central Park, New York City. A park photo, not one of these events.

news.text: The Vessel at Hudson Yards holds its second holiday lighting on Nov 16, free, with Anthony Ramos headlining.
Macy's parade turns 100 on Nov 26, with a record 100 inflatables, per NYC Tourism.

picks.label: Spending nothing on tickets
picks.why: Bryant Park skating is free only with your own skates.

picks.label: Under 3
picks.why: Both list babies free: 0 to 2 at Lightscape, 2 and under at the zoo.

picks.label: Cold or wet day
picks.why: The trains run inside a warm conservatory; the show is indoors.

picks.label: Early bedtime
picks.why: Skate before 10:30 a.m., reach the zoo at 1 p.m., or see the trains by day.

picks.label: Sensory needs
picks.why: Each lists special sessions; the dates are on its card.

items.text: Gingerbread NYC, Museum of the City of New York: opens Nov 6
Harlem Holiday Lights, West 125th Street: Nov 17
Origami Holiday Tree, American Museum of Natural History: opens Nov 23
The Nutcracker, New York City Ballet: Nov 27 to Jan 3, sensory-friendly show Jan 3
Winter Village Metropolis, Children's Museum of Manhattan: Dec 8 to 31
Holiday markets: Union Square, Columbus Circle, Grand Central Holiday Fair

new-york-city.not_listed: Dyker Heights lights: the only official write-up we found dates from 2011, so we have no current details to share.

events.name: Macy's Thanksgiving Day Parade
events.place: Central Park West at W 77th St to Herald Square, Manhattan
events.cost_note: Free to watch, per NYC Tourism.
kids: The 100th parade, with a record 100 inflatables
Street viewing along the route
events.extra: Getting there, food and any paid viewing packages.
events.watch: NYC Tourism's page lists no start time or viewing spots, and we could not read Macy's own page. Check both before you plan the morning.

events.name: Vessel holiday lighting
events.cost_note: The ceremony is free and open to the public.
kids: Live show with Anthony Ramos and a drumline
Over by 7 p.m., so it can work before bedtime
events.extra: The inside holiday display is $10 a ticket, 7 to 9 p.m.
events.watch: It's on a school night. The page doesn't say whether display tickets sell out or need buying ahead.

events.name: Bryant Park ice rink
events.dates: Now to Feb 28, 2027, weather permitting; 8 a.m. to midnight Nov 19 to Jan 3
events.cost_note: Free with your own skates and a reserved ticket. Rentals run $18.72 to $64.48 each, fee included, cheaper off-peak. Four rentals: ≈ $75 to $258.
kids: Skate aids for small kids, $26, free before 10:30 a.m. if available
Free helmets; kids' skates from size 6T
Stroller parking from mid-November, first come
events.extra: Skate aids $26, socks or a lock $6.24 each, bag check $6.24 an item.
events.watch: Under-14s need an adult, and you can't carry a child while skating. A non-skating adult gets in free per two kids under 14; extras cost $11.29. No re-entry. Own-skates tickets are released a week ahead.

events.name: Rockefeller Center tree
events.dates: Lights on Dec 2; up to Jan 9, per news reports
events.cost_note: None of the pages we read lists a ticket to see the tree. NYC Tourism only says December for the lighting.
kids: Time Out calls the lighting-night crowd an attraction of its own, so any other day may suit small kids better
In Midtown, like Radio City and Bryant Park
events.extra: The rink next to the tree is separately priced; we could not read its prices.
events.watch: We could not read Rockefeller Center's own page. The Dec 2 lighting comes from NY1 and Time Out, and the Jan 9 end from NY1. Check the center's page for visiting hours.

events.name: Lightscape
events.cost_note: Fees included. Adult $29 Value nights, $39 off-peak, $44 peak; child 3-11 $15, $22, $28; age 0-2 free. The page doesn't say which nights are which: the ticket calendar will.
kids: An outdoor walking trail of light displays
Wheelchair-accessible paths; no strobes, but some flashing lights
Sensory-friendly early entry at 4 p.m., Dec 3 and Dec 18
events.watch: Dec 10 and Dec 17 are 21+ nights, so skip those with kids. Earplugs are free at the box office. Trail length and stroller rules aren't on the page.

events.name: Bronx Zoo Holiday Lights
events.cost_note: Dated tickets: adult $29.95 or $37.95, child 3-12 $14.95 or $22.95, age 2 and under free. An any-night ticket is ≈ $142 for 4.
kids: Arrive from 1 p.m. to see animals by day before the lights
New this year: the Children's Zoo Farmyard opens for the lights
Sensory Inclusive Night on Dec 3, reserve ahead
events.extra: Holiday Train $4 a ride; car parking $22 (zoo's rates page, read Nov 2).
events.watch: It runs rain or shine. The calendar on the ticket page shows which nights are open. Stroller rules aren't on the pages we read.
events.source_label: Bronx Zoo Holiday Lights tickets page

events.name: NYBG Holiday Train Show
events.dates: Nov 14, 2026 to Jan 10, 2027; open to 8 p.m. on select evenings
events.cost_note: All-Garden Pass, which NYBG says includes the show: adult $35 weekday, $39 weekend; child $15, $17; under 2 free. Last season's show tickets charged kids more ($25-$27), so check your date.
kids: Model trains inside a warm glass conservatory
Sensory-friendly mornings: Nov 21 and Jan 9, 9 to 11 a.m., with music off
Allow about 3 hours, per NYBG's guide from last season
events.extra: Parking was $22 last season, first come.
events.watch: Last season NYBG called weekdays the quietest and Dec 20 to Jan 3 the busiest, with timed entry by day. Check whether that holds this year.

events.name: Christmas Spectacular
events.place: Radio City Music Hall, Midtown Manhattan
events.cost_note: The official pages we read show no prices; they send you to the ticket calendar.
kids: 90 minutes with no intermission
Under 2 sits on a lap with no ticket
Free stroller check; free sensory bags with headphones, ID needed
events.extra: Prices vary by date and seat; check fees at checkout.
events.watch: It has sudden loud noises, flashing lights, smoke, confetti and pyrotechnics, so think about that for little ones. No minimum age is listed.
